title: Lửa tàn
about: Round x6, for sleep (style ngu-ngon), as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm cho tôi nhiều bài nữa, phù hợp cho các người nghe có thể nghe để ngủ"): the last embers of a fire: a far organ, very soft and warm, the felt piano now and then, a deep sub; it grows quieter and quieter. G minor at 46 bpm, about six minutes. Nothing sudden: no thunder, heartbeat or struck bells. An original piece.
